text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun showed me something
remarkable at the tryout race
the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wander the academy grounds, hoping to
meet the spirited racer one
more time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up, Yukipe! Don't you wanna watch
Gold City race with your
own eyes? Let's
get moving!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
H-hold up, Maya! On second thought, I'm
not sure if I wanna go... I've
never been
'round so many people...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
C'moooon, you'll be fiiine! I'll be with you
the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait. I think I've seen you before...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! You're that trainer I met at
tryouts! Wow, funny seeing you
again!
Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me? Waaait, this is like...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Such a grown-up situation! Squee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Buuut I'm kinda in a hurry right now, so...
as much as I wanna talk,
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I have an idea! Why don't you come
with us? That'd be perfect!
Right, Yukipe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? U-uhhh... Maya? What're you—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're coming with us! It's time for takeoff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before either Yukino Bijin or I can
interject, Mayano Top Gun grabs
the two
of us by our wrists and drags us along with
her.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are now approaching the
fourth and final corner! Gold
City makes a
beautiful turn from the track's outer side!
And right
behind her is Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll show ya what true grit looks like!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're not going anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Wooow! City's really someth'n else!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! City and Tamamo are both
sooo cool! It's like they're
twinkling!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... So you can go zoooom there? I never would've thought that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Watching grown-up Umamusume race is
always suuuper exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's eyes are twinkling with
joy, and her gaze is glued
to the top
Umamusume from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Finiiish! Tamamo Cross takes first place! A
close second, Gold City
follows right
behind her!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Yeah! Victory's mine!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Dang it, I messed up the timing on my
sprint...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. This won't happen again. Mark my
words, Tamamo. I'm going
to win next
time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Sounds like a challenge if I've
ever heard one! I'll take ya
up on dat any
time, any day, City!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That race was amaz'n! Tamamo and
City were both so cool!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So she shouldn't have gone bam there... It was too early! And City figured that out... She really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ughhh, watching twinkly grown-ups race makes my heart keep going all badump, badump... I wanna be twinkly too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! There's always something new to
learn from these big races! So
watching
them makes my heart go badump!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All those racers are so much more
experienced and grown up! And

grown-ups are twinkly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So like, I wanna be like that too! I wanna
be all twinkly and running in
races that
make people go badump!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Awww, maaan. I wanna run in the Twinkle
Series toooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
M-me too! G1 might be a ways away, but
I'll get there one day! I
hafta!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get ourselves back to the
academy and start train'n!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Blegh, training?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna! I'm not gonna! Training
sucks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna explore the racetrack! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait, Maya! Geez, she's already gone...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way! There's noth'n Maya can't do!
Once she puts her mind to
someth'n, you
can't stop her. She's amaz'n like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Like when she got used to runn'n on the
dirt tracks real quick! And
I've never seen
her even break a sweat dur'n our dance
lessons!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's even good at study'n! Anyway, if she
says "I got it," then she's
really got it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, Maya says it heaps of times. For
everyth'n, actually! She gets
it all! It's
amazing, really...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Yukino Bijin, I feel like I have a
slightly better
understanding of Mayano
Top Gun and her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a prodigious ability to "get it"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That is, her astounding intuition that
always leads her down the right
path. She's
a bona fide genius!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, she has no interest
whatsoev'r in training... Ever
since our first
session, she hasn't shown up at all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And 'cause of that, she isn't
allowed to run in any races—not
even
scrimm'ges!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I get that races are where you're s'pposed
to show the fruits of your
training, but... I
dunno... I still feel sorry for Maya. The
poor thing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about Mayano Top
Gun. She wants to race more
than
anything, yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is there anything I can do for her?
